newsitem.title: DENMARK: Foreign Danish bond purchases down in September.
newsitem.headline: Foreign Danish bond purchases down in September.

text.p: Foreign investors bought a net 7.9 billion crowns worth of Danish bonds in September, down from 8.5 billion in August the central bank said, without comment, on Monday.
Of the September investments, 3.8 billion crowns went on government bonds and 4.1 billion on mortgage-backed bonds, the office said.
Foreign buyers also acquired shares to the value of 1.1 billion crowns in September, it added.
